name: Couples
intro: Where a daily ritual keeps the couple close and the link between phones holds, and where the content runs out and sync breaks.

apps.title: SumOne: For Relationships
apps.verdict: Couples genuinely stick with it: they answer questions about each other for years and say it shows how a partner is feeling during the day. It breaks on ads: minute-long clips for 3 pebbles, ads after every question, and sometimes it stops opening after an update with no warning.
apps.loved: Daily questions that spark conversation, learning your partner deeper, sense of connection at a distance, responsive support when moving an account, eggmon pet and small side activities
apps.weak: Minute-long ads for a few pebbles, ads after every question, slow currency grind, some questions with a negative slant, VIP became a subscription instead of a one-time buy, crashes and lost access after switching phones
apps.whoFor: A couple that wants to learn about each other daily through questions and is willing to tolerate ads or pay to remove them

apps.title: The Couple (Days in Love)
apps.verdict: It is a shared journal and days-in-love counter, and people actually keep it for hundreds of days, especially valuing the shared diary with premium. The weak spots are concrete: the counter sometimes miscounts by a day, the app has lost entries and wiped data, it changes language and dates on its own, and an ad pops up on every action. People ask for a relationship-pause option, more free themes, and premium syncing between partners.
apps.loved: Shared couple's journal, days-in-love counter, anniversary tracking, use over hundreds of days, premium themes
apps.weak: Counter off by a day, lost entries and wiped data, changes language and dates on its own, ad on every action, premium not visible to the second partner
apps.whoFor: Couples who want a shared relationship journal and day-counter with nice design

apps.title: Lovewick: Relationship Tracker
apps.verdict: Couples genuinely love the question cards as a prompt to talk over dinner and before bed, plus the memory feed with photos and dates. But a recent update cut free cards from 10 a day down to one, which enraged long-time users who feel cheated. People also complain the app freezes when you answer from a notification and that questions sometimes just won't load.
apps.loved: Question cards for talking over dinner and before bed, memory feed with photo captions, date ideas, tracking important dates
apps.weak: Free cards cut from 10 to 1 per day, freezes when answering from a notification, questions sometimes won't load, repeated questions, unavailable in several countries
apps.whoFor: Couples who want a gentle prompt to get to know each other and store shared memories, if they'll pay for full access

quotes.text: My husband and I have loved the questions and especially used them during dinners to start conversations.
I love being able to scroll down and go back in time through my relationship. As someone with a bad memory, writing a caption for each picture helps me hold on to those moments.

apps.title: Paired: Couples & Relationship
apps.verdict: Couples value the quality of the questions that help them learn about each other and start conversations they would not start on their own, some discover new things even after decades together. The weakest part is that after showing results the app gives no advice on how to fix the areas where you scored low, the questions grow stale over time, and the head-to-head mini-games annoy many people. There is a lot of anger about being charged for a full year at once and about the subscription not being obvious upfront.
apps.loved: Quality and depth of the questions, helps you learn about your partner and start awkward conversations, works even for long-together couples, secret missions
apps.weak: No advice on how to improve areas you scored low on, questions get stale and repeat, versus games annoy people, questions aimed at long-term couples not new ones, charged for a full year at once and unclear subscription
apps.whoFor: Couples who want to learn more about each other and get talking, and are willing to pay a subscription

quotes.text: My husband and I have been using this app for 2 weeks. So far, we have both really enjoyed it. After 28 years of marriage, we were surprised to find we could still learn more about each other!!
after 2+ years of using this app, the questions can become quite stale (and even sometimes very confusing). We need to mix it up a bit more so will be looking into another app
if your partner doesn't do it, it's nothing you can do. I wish they would've taken that part into consideration when making this app... So I basically was doing this for nothing.
We are competitive which makes us laugh but most of all throughout the day at work it lets us know we are thinking of each other
The app has nice questions, games and tests, but it does not show you or give you insights based on the results on how to improve or how to work on the relationship.
I only wish it offered advice or tips on how to work to improve certain things that you score low on. If it could suggest a couple questions to get a conversation going, that would be great

apps.title: My Love - Relationship Counter
apps.verdict: People genuinely love watching how many days and months their relationship has lasted and sharing that counter to social media. But the app nags for a rating far too aggressively, the popup shows up every single time you open it and even covers the screen when someone wants a screenshot. The feature set is narrow, and one user honestly asks for birthdays and important dates about his partner.
apps.loved: Days and months relationship counter, simplicity, accurate count, sharing the counter anywhere
apps.weak: Constant rate-this-app popup appears on every open, blocks the screen and gets in the way of screenshots, very little to do beyond the counter itself
apps.whoFor: Couples who just want to see and show off how long they have been together

apps.title: Candle: Couples & Relationship
apps.verdict: Couples, especially long-distance, take to the daily questions, daily photos and widgets, and people say they learn things they'd never think to ask. It breaks on money and small glitches: you pay per partner separately, every update hides more behind a subscription, and drawing gets laggy over time while the camera sometimes fails to upload a photo.
apps.loved: Daily questions for closeness, daily photos of each other, home-screen widgets, drawing on a shared canvas, the streak as a ritual, long-distance help, oddly deep questions about a partner
apps.weak: You pay per partner separately, every update hides more behind a subscription, drawing gets laggy over time, camera sometimes won't upload a photo, a 2-question daily limit, odd or inappropriate questions, can't write your own questions
apps.whoFor: A long-distance couple that wants a daily ritual of questions and photos and is fine paying for two

quotes.text: Me and my boyfriend love this app and keeping our streak. Being able to ask different things of each other that remind me of that getting to know you stage. But I would say the only suggestion I could make is a streak shield.
now it only lets us answer 2 questions and I currently can't even see my boyfriend's answer's to the questions and I can't see the photo he sent

apps.title: Evergreen: Relationship Growth
apps.verdict: Couples say the app genuinely helps them open up and have deeper conversations, and for many it is a great foundation for the relationship. But it hurts a lot that the free part was cut in half, from four daily activities with your partner down to two, and the tree itself will not grow without a subscription. It is also technically shaky, streaks break for a day or two, the weekly check-in gets stuck and does not refresh, plus many complaints about being charged after supposedly cancelling.
apps.loved: Helps you open up and have deeper conversations, daily activities and quizzes, the growing relationship tree metaphor, simplicity and engagement
apps.weak: Free tier cut from four daily activities to two, the tree will not grow without a subscription, streaks break for a day or two, the weekly check-in gets stuck and will not refresh, quizzes run out in a couple of months and repeat, charges after cancellation
apps.whoFor: Couples who want to talk more deeply and work on the relationship every day, and are willing to pay

quotes.text: Recently the tasked questions have been skipping a day or two at a time making my bf and I lose a 169 day streak. Love the app it's just a little frustrating

apps.title: My Love-Relationship Countdown
apps.verdict: A cute tracker couples take to: it counts days, minutes and seconds together, keeps the first kiss and first date, sends love quotes and lets you change themes. It breaks where it matters: you can't count up instead of down, notifications glitch with wrong dates, and after a phone reset people lose all their events with no way to restore.
apps.loved: Counting days, minutes and seconds together, keeping key dates like the first date, love quotes to send each other, changeable themes, accuracy down to the exact start time
apps.weak: Can't switch to count-up, wrong dates in new-milestone notifications, all events lost after a phone reset with no recovery, many features behind a subscription, ads in what is basically a calendar, a forgotten passcode with no password reset
apps.whoFor: A couple that loves marking dates and relationship milestones and wants a pretty tracker with reminders

quotes.text: Once I downloaded my apps again I lost everything on this app. All the events, dates, etc.

apps.title: Cupla: Shared Couples Calendar
apps.verdict: It is a shared calendar for couples, taken to coordinate work schedules, plan dates, keep wishlists and keep both partners in the loop, syncing with Google, Outlook and Apple. It breaks at the free-versus-paid line: without paying you cannot see your partner's events or the whole month, only a week, which kills the point. There are bugs: widgets go white after an update, dates vanish on iOS 26, and the calendar sometimes wipes itself. The forced AI assistant is annoying and cannot be turned off.
apps.loved: Shared couple's calendar, coordinating work schedules, planning dates, wishlists, syncing with Google and Outlook, responsive developer
apps.weak: Cannot see partner's events or the full month without paying, widgets go white, dates vanish on iOS 26, calendar wipes itself, forced AI assistant
apps.whoFor: Busy couples and spouses who need to merge work schedules, dates and to-dos into one shared calendar

apps.title: Just Between Us - Couples Chat
apps.verdict: Couples value a fully private chat just for two, where photos stay blurred until you tap and messages never mix with regular texts. The job they hire it for is clear: intimate talk with no risk kids or CarPlay expose it. It breaks on reliability: messages don't arrive, an encryption-key error wipes old photos and messages, and videos longer than 45 seconds won't upload.
apps.loved: Private channel just for two, photos blurred until tapped, warming up before date night, protection from kids or CarPlay accidentally exposing it
apps.weak: Messages sometimes don't arrive, encryption-key error erases old chats, short video limit, can't resend gallery photos inside the app, weak support
apps.whoFor: Couples, especially with kids or traveling, who need to talk intimately and privately apart from regular messengers

quotes.text: My kids share my cell phone account (on iPads) in order to keep them safe. That also limits what I can discuss with my spouse via text…thx to this app, we can go back to discussing everything again, like adults.
we have had multiple instances where one of us would send a message only to find out later it was never received. This app is not reliable at its prim
we have had multiple instances where one of us would send a message only to find out later it was never received

apps.title: Cozy Couples: Relationship App
apps.verdict: Long-distance couples love this shared cozy home where you can swap furniture, set a mood through light and answer a daily question, and for many it is a way to stay together across distance. But people are furious that almost everything is pushed behind a subscription, including previously free items and viewing old answers, and the new PLUS tier feels like it holds their history hostage. There are not enough emotions in the mood light, no room for more than two partners, and lately request-timed-out errors keep breaking sync.
apps.loved: Shared cozy home for a couple, decorating and customizing the room, mood light indicator, daily question and trivia games, caring for a shared pet, long-distance connection
apps.weak: Almost everything behind a subscription including previously free items and viewing old answers, the new PLUS tier feels like it holds your history hostage, too few emotion options in the mood light, cannot add a third partner, request-timed-out errors and broken sync, weak support
apps.whoFor: Couples, especially long-distance, who want a shared cozy space and a daily ritual

quotes.text: when my boyfriend and I are apart for a while it's fun to still be connected through 'our house'. The daily questions are always exciting and the trivia games I find really fun.

apps.title: ReGain - Couples Therapy
apps.verdict: When you land on the right therapist, people praise it sincerely and say they feel helped and that remote therapy is convenient. Everything around it breaks: charges with no sessions scheduled, penalties for missing when the app freezes, no way to remove an ex-partner after a breakup, and video sessions that freeze and glitch.
apps.loved: Convenient remote couples therapy, strong therapists on a good match, smooth connection to a counselor, available classes and recordings of missed ones
apps.weak: Charges with no sessions delivered, penalties for a miss caused by app glitches, no live support beyond email, can't remove an ex-partner, broken partner invite links, freezing video calls, cases of an unprofessional therapist
apps.whoFor: A couple that needs remote therapy and is willing to gamble on the therapist match and put up with technical failures

apps.title: Couple Widget : Love Countdown
apps.verdict: The core function works well and keeps people for years: a widget with a day-counter, the relationship start date, anniversaries and birthdays, plus daily quotes. Customization breaks down: you cannot properly set your own photo on the widget, the app swaps it for its own picture, the shared photo drops off, and entered dates sometimes vanish. The long ad on launch is annoying.
apps.loved: Days-together counter, anniversary and birthday tracking, daily quotes, nice design, years of stable use
apps.weak: Cannot set your own widget photo, app swaps the picture, shared photo drops off, dates vanish, long ad on launch
apps.whoFor: Couples who want a simple, pretty widget with a relationship counter and reminders of important dates

apps.title: Between, Couples Love Tracker
apps.verdict: Long-term couples keep Between as their main way to communicate instead of regular texts, valuing the private separate channel, stickers, shared calendar and photo cloud. The huge pain is that for some people old photos and years of chats suddenly vanish, files older than a few months turn into gray boxes, and support goes silent for months. On top of that the app has not been updated in a long time, there are no reactions or replies to messages, and by today's standards it is a very basic messenger.
apps.loved: Private separate communication instead of iMessage, stickers, shared calendar, cloud and days-together counter, reliability in everyday chat for long-term couples
apps.weak: Sudden loss of old photos and years of chats, files older than a few months turn into gray boxes, support goes silent for months, app not updated in a long time, no reactions or replies to messages, crashes on older iPhones
apps.whoFor: Couples who want a permanent separate private channel for communication instead of regular texts, and can live with a very basic feature set

quotes.text: My partner and I have been using Between for something like 7 years now (been together for 8 years). We love it. Once you've used Between, normal texts are boring and annoying.
Then one day I signed in and 90% of my photos and chats were gone. Years and years worth of photos and convos gone.

apps.title: noteit - bff widget
apps.verdict: People genuinely love drawing notes by hand and seeing them on their partner's widget, and for long-distance relationships it is a warm connection, almost like Snapchat for those not allowed to have it. But the app badly lets people down on reliability, notes often fail to send with an error, the widget does not refresh in the background so you have to open it manually, and long 30-40 minute drawings sometimes just will not send. A sore spot is streaks, they charge to repair them, and after 200 days the blooming vine effect stops working.
apps.loved: Hand-drawn notes on your partner's widget, warm long-distance connection, sharing photos and drawings, counter of days with your person, Snapchat-like vibe
apps.weak: Notes often fail to send and crash with an error, widget does not refresh in the background so you must open it manually, paid streak repair, the blooming vine effect breaks after 200 days, cannot add more than one person, crashes and freezes
apps.whoFor: Couples and close friends, especially long-distance, who care about hand-drawn notes and a shared streak

quotes.text: Me and my gf enjoyed watching it grow and blossom but now we just keep our streak alive with a blank
App doesn't automatically refresh in the background to see the newest note sent by partner. You have to manually open the app to view the newest note
I really love using this app with my long-distance partner. It's been a meaningful way for us to stay connected. However, recently I've experienced frequent crashes when opening the app

apps.title: Lasting: Marriage & Couples
apps.verdict: Couples value the daily question and the structured lessons, and for some it is a lifeline when in-person couples therapists are unavailable but they still want to work on the relationship. But the app is technically shaky, answers sometimes do not save, dates and times drift, sync lags, and old progress gets in the way of starting fresh. Many are put off by the high price, which they compare to real therapy, and by the murky cancellation where the app and website bounce you back and forth.
apps.loved: Quality of the daily question and lessons, structured exercises and date-night workshops, helps when in-person therapy is unavailable, responsive support for some people
apps.weak: Answers sometimes do not save and dates drift, sync delays, old progress gets in the way of starting over, high price comparable to therapy, confusing cancellation where app and website bounce you around, too little content for a subscription, no mediator for discussing answers together
apps.whoFor: Couples and spouses who want to work on the relationship in a structured way and can accept therapy-level pricing

quotes.text: We have completed numerous sessions and had some good conversations come from them. However, it feels like it just ends there. Would be nice to at least get some feedback on our responses

Love the lessons and prompts for the individual experience but it leaves it up to the couple to discuss questions/answers together without a mediator and I feel like that's where a lot of couples (mine included) need help.

apps.title: Loveit. couples & real friends
apps.verdict: People get it for hand-drawn notes and a widget with the partner's photo on the home screen, and long-distance couples especially value swapping little notes every day. What ruins it is a flood of ads and that almost everything runs into the subscription: without premium notes often will not send. There are bugs too: the widget goes white, drawing lags, and you cannot zoom the canvas.
apps.loved: Hand-drawn notes, widget with partner's photo on screen, swapping notes long-distance, Lifetime for 14 dollars
apps.weak: Tons of ads, notes will not send without premium, widget goes white and breaks, drawing lags, cannot zoom canvas
apps.whoFor: Couples and close friends who want to swap cute hand-drawn notes and keep each other's photo on the home screen

apps.title: Couple Tree: For Relationship
apps.verdict: The cute art and a shared forest the couple grows together by answering daily questions genuinely hook people. But many complain trees and logs drop far too randomly, and the free version is buried under 30-second ads. There are also frequent technical failures: blank or gray screens, losing the connection to your partner, freezing and phone overheating after ads, plus questions that spark fights more than closeness.
apps.loved: Cute art and pets, a shared forest the couple grows together, daily questions for openness, cheap one-time premium for both partners
apps.weak: Too many 30-second ads without premium, logs and trees drop too randomly, blank or gray screen, losing connection to partner, phone overheating and freezing, questions sometimes spark fights
apps.whoFor: Young couples who enjoy a cute pet-and-questions game, if they'll make a one-time premium purchase to remove ads

quotes.text: i wish tree logs weren't so hard to get, like the randomness there is to getting one is a major set back bc everything in the shop is bought with them

apps.title: Couple Joy - Relationship App
apps.verdict: Couples value the widgets, daily questions and shared quizzes as a reason to stay in touch. But people are put off that the free version gives you literally one set from each category before hitting a wall, so many call it a demo. The AI images in the prompts feel cheap, the daily-streak reset time is inconvenient, and every update seems to reset the streak with a paid repair.
apps.loved: Couple widgets, daily questions and check-ins, shared quizzes, fun time together
apps.weak: Almost everything behind a subscription with only one free set per category feels like a demo, AI images in the prompts look cheap, inconvenient streak reset time and frequent resets after updates with paid repair, inaccurate location widget
apps.whoFor: Couples who want light daily questions and widgets, if they are willing to pay a subscription

quotes.text: it expires at a really inconvenient time instead of until the end of day deadline by the calendar date. This is the only app I have that constantly has broken streaks

apps.title: Love Nudge
apps.verdict: Almost everyone likes the idea: mark how full your partner's love tank is and get ideas to care for them in their love language. It breaks on execution: people can't figure out how to share goals and mark them done, and the note you write when rating the tank is only visible to you, which many call the biggest failure.
apps.loved: The five love languages concept, the love tank as a way to signal your state to a partner, daily prompt ideas for caring, help with long-distance relationships
apps.weak: Unclear how to share goals and mark them complete, the note on a tank rating isn't visible to the partner, tiny unreadable text, keyboard hides the partner's message, can't mark a goal for a past day, a partner is mandatory to finish the quiz
apps.whoFor: A couple that already knows about love languages and is willing to work through a non-obvious interface for shared caring

quotes.text: I don't know how to share my goals to my husband, and I don't know how to fill his tank!

apps.title: Love8 - App for Couples
apps.verdict: The app hooks couples with a day-counter widget and a shared virtual pet, and that is what people love, especially in long-distance relationships. It breaks on the coin economy: the pet is constantly out of food, they added sleep and potty with no free option, and coins drain fast. There are also complaints about battery drain, phone overheating, and basic things like the partner map being locked behind payment.
apps.loved: Relationship day-counter widget, shared virtual pet, feeling connected to partner, long-distance check-ins
apps.weak: Coins run out, nothing to feed the pet, battery drain and phone overheating, partner map only paid, weak support
apps.whoFor: Couples who enjoy playfully caring for a shared pet and a day-counter, especially in long-distance relationships

quotes.text: I somehow keep tuning into the issue of not having enough coins to buy any of the items for food... it keeps me from being able to complete tasks

apps.title: inlove - D-Day for Couples
apps.verdict: The app looks pretty and handy, and couples like the design and notifications on meaningful dates. But nearly every other review is about one thing: there are too many ads, they're intrusive, and removing them costs money, which annoys many.
apps.loved: Pretty design, convenience, notifications on meaningful dates, cute look, a countdown for couples
apps.weak: Too many intrusive ads, ad removal only for money, can't change gender in the profile, won't open on an old iPhone 6s after an update
apps.whoFor: A couple that cares about a pretty relationship counter and is willing to tolerate ads or pay to remove them

apps.title: Couple360-Relationship App
apps.verdict: Couples get it to swap story photos that show up right on each other's home screen and for a countdown widget to their next meeting, especially long-distance. It breaks at sign-in: it keeps logging you out, creates duplicate accounts, loses data, and will not let you set an avatar. After the trial the free mode shrinks to one snap every 12 hours and a lot goes behind payment, plus battery drain. People ask for plain messaging and reactions.
apps.loved: Swapping story photos on the home screen, countdown to the next meeting, sense of connection long-distance, ease of use
apps.weak: Keeps logging out and losing the account, duplicate profiles, avatar will not set, one snap every 12 hours after trial, battery drain
apps.whoFor: Long-distance couples who want to swap photo moments and see a countdown to their next meeting on screen

apps.title: Widgetable: Besties & Couples
apps.verdict: A sweet idea, raising a shared virtual pet with a friend or partner and keeping a widget on your screen, and people genuinely enjoy it. But the economy is tuned so hard that coins are painful to earn, pets get hungry every 30 minutes, and ads pop up literally every time you come back to the app, sometimes without paying out the promised reward. A couple of people hit a fake malware ad and nearly got signed up for a paid plan by accident.
apps.loved: Shared pet with a friend or partner, pet widget on the home screen, mini-games together, cute design, helps stay connected without texting
apps.weak: Too many long ads up to two minutes, coins are very hard to earn and pets get hungry every 30 minutes, ad rewards sometimes not credited, fake malware ads slip through, easy to accidentally start a paid plan
apps.whoFor: Friends and couples, especially long-distance, who want shared cute pet care instead of texting

quotes.text: pets get hungry often and mini-games do not reward very much coins. Even the daily wheel offers such pitiful amounts. 5-10 coins on the wheel?

apps.title: Couple Games Questions · DeepQ
apps.verdict: It is a set of deep questions for couples, good for passing an evening at a bar or getting a boyfriend and girlfriend to open up to each other. The catch is that almost all the meaningful content sits behind a 7.99-a-week subscription, and people call the free questions basic and generic. Many are annoyed that it begs for a rating every third action and that there is no interaction between partners inside the app.
apps.loved: Deep questions for couples, helps you open up to each other, good for passing an evening together
apps.weak: Meaningful questions behind a 7.99-weekly plan, free questions are basic, constant rating prompts, no partner interaction
apps.whoFor: Couples who want a ready set of questions for a heart-to-heart over an evening, if the weekly charge is fine

apps.title: Lovify: Couple Questions Games
apps.verdict: A quiz game where couples guess each other's answers works as a talking prompt, especially long distance, and people get pulled into deeper topics. But the core breakage shows up again and again: answers and questions don't sync between partners, phones show different questions when compared, and matches are effectively made up. It also freezes often, and questions run out fast after paying for premium.
apps.loved: Quiz guessing your partner's answers, a prompt to talk long distance, helps dig into topics deeper, easy start for a new couple
apps.weak: Answers and questions don't sync between partners, matches come out fabricated, freezes often and won't open, questions run out fast after paying, awkward wording
apps.whoFor: Couples, especially long distance, who want to learn about each other through a quiz, if they can tolerate the sync problems and running out of questions

quotes.text: The questions don't match with what your partner sees. My partner and I answered questions and when we compared phones, they were completely different questions we hadn't answered, so the answers were made up.
it doesn't always reflect the true answers your partner picked, which got frustrating quickly and ultimately made us decide to end the game.

apps.title: My Love・Relationship Tracker
apps.verdict: The core is simple and clear: a relationship tracker with a days-together counter and a timeline of events, and some like it as a cute way to follow the relationship. It breaks because the most basic things are paid: you cannot even see the relationship start date or set your own photo without a subscription, and the pay screen jumps up on every open. There are bugs: the timeline hits a limit and will not let you add events, and support does not respond.
apps.loved: Days-together counter, relationship event timeline, cute and clear design, easy way to follow the relationship
apps.weak: Day-counter and your own photo only with a subscription, pay screen on every open, ads, timeline hits a limit, support silent
apps.whoFor: Couples who want a simple days-together tracker with a timeline, if they are fine paying for basic features

apps.title: Couple Game: Relationship Quiz
apps.verdict: The game itself lands with couples and friends: they laugh, compete and learn about each other through quizzes. But it breaks on two things: 60 seconds of ads on every launch and after almost every action, and a paid premium that widely fails to apply, so the clips don't go away, quizzes stay locked, and support doesn't reply.
apps.loved: Fun quizzes for couples and friends, a reason to laugh and compete, learning about each other through questions, good for a date night at home
apps.weak: 60 seconds of ads on launch and after almost every action, ads hard to close, paid premium not applied, ads remain even after paying, quizzes stay locked after purchase, a partner doesn't receive their share of the subscription, silent support, half a year with no updates
apps.whoFor: A couple or friends wanting a laugh for an evening, if they can tolerate an ad barrage and possibly pay for premium in vain

apps.title: Coral: Couples & Relationship
apps.verdict: The idea is strong: a private couple's chat, questions, exercises and prompts that genuinely open up talk about feelings, and some people have used it for years. But the tech keeps failing: chat does not work between iPhone and Samsung, the app freezes and drops to a white screen after first launch, and quizzes will not submit. On top of that it nags for a review after every step and charges 60 dollars a year with no monthly option.
apps.loved: Private couple's chat, questions and exercises for talking about feelings, help communicating with a partner, thoughtful prompts
apps.weak: Chat fails between iPhone and Android, freezes and white screen, quizzes will not submit, nagging review prompts, no monthly plan
apps.whoFor: Couples willing to pay for a yearly plan for structured exercises and questions, if both actually engage

quotes.text: There needs to be some type of motivation within the app... Something to get my partner to actually use it. I'm all over the app checking things out and they could care less.
Great app, it's best if your partner is into it though.

apps.title: Couples Games & Challenges
apps.verdict: The idea is simple, truth or dare for a couple or friends, and it does get a conversation going and opens up communication. But the content quickly starts repeating, the free tier is thin, and the paid packs ask you to pay again when you switch phones or after restoring a purchase. People complain that even the extreme level is bland, and that this app is basically a copy of another of their own games with the same content.
apps.loved: Simple truth-or-dare format for a couple or friends, opens up communication and conversation, easy interface
apps.weak: Content repeats fast and there is little of it, thin free tier and pricey paid packs, even the extreme level is bland, purchases ask you to pay again when you switch phones, basically a copy of another of their own games, does not work offline
apps.whoFor: Couples or groups who want a light truth-or-dare game to spark conversation, with low expectations

apps.title: Loverzz: Couples App & Widgets
apps.verdict: People like the idea: quizzes spark conversations they'd never start on their own, plus there are shared doodles, notes and widgets for your partner, which helps long distance. But a huge share of the content is locked behind payment, and even after one partner buys, the other gets asked to pay again. Add the bugs: freezing on entering the anniversary, completed games resetting, being asked to pay again after buying. The text average is just 2.76 against 4.61 in the store, and the praise five-stars sound suspiciously promotional.
apps.loved: Quizzes spark unusual conversations, shared doodles and notes for your partner, widgets, helps long-distance couples
apps.weak: Almost everything locked behind payment, second partner asked to pay after the first buys, freezes on entering the anniversary, completed games reset, asked to pay again after buying
apps.whoFor: Long-distance couples who want quizzes and widgets to stay connected, if they'll pay and put up with progress resets

quotes.text: My bf & I are long distance and this app is the only one I've found that actually works. It helps the distance not feel as hard. So thankful!!!! <3

apps.title: LiveStatus - App for couples
apps.verdict: The idea appeals: a partner's status on the lock screen and widgets, a shared pet, photos back and forth, and people kept and loved it for years. But right now the product is down: sign-in throws 503 and temporarily-unavailable, the shared pet shows up for no one, photos and stickers won't load, and it isn't fixed even for those who bought lifetime access.
apps.loved: Partner's status on the lock screen and widgets, custom status, a shared pet, photo exchange, an easy way to keep each other updated through the day, some free features
apps.weak: 503 and temporarily-unavailable errors on sign-in, the shared pet invisible to everyone, photos and stickers won't load, notifications broken, slow loading, unfixed even for lifetime buyers, some of the good stuff behind pro
apps.whoFor: A couple that wants a partner's status on screen and a shared pet, but the app is too broken right now to recommend

quotes.text: Me and my boyfriend have been using this app nearly everyday for years and it's amazing. The custom status option is my favorite... Unfortunately though it stopped working a couple days/weeks ago

apps.title: Couples - Better Relationships
apps.verdict: The idea is good: a daily question for couples as a reason to talk and learn about each other, and some built it into a morning ritual. But free gives you exactly one question a day, everything else is behind a 5-dollar-weekly plan, and the content barely updates: half a year with no new questions, Christmas and New Year themes shown in spring. There are bugs: answers get attributed to the wrong partner, money is charged on the first trial day, and it will not open.
apps.loved: Daily question to spark talk, a reason to learn about your partner, helps start conversations in long relationships
apps.weak: One free question a day, everything behind a 5-dollar-weekly plan, content not updated for half a year, answers attributed to the wrong person, charge on the first trial day
apps.whoFor: Couples in long relationships who want a daily reason to talk, if they are fine paying for a thin set

quotes.text: Why are we getting so many Christmas and new years questions in April?
I filled out about 16 surveys and when my partner logged in it showed that HE filled it in, not me... and therefore we weren't compatible on anything!

apps.title: Relatio: Couples Relationship
apps.verdict: The first lesson sometimes lands and a few feel the material is worth the time, but the content is a mixed bag pulled from different frameworks with no coherence. It breaks on money and bait-and-switch: the subscription can't be cancelled through Apple, they charge 50-75 dollars with no refund, and instead of the promised couples help the app drifts into erectile-dysfunction content and demands extra pay for a coach.
apps.loved: A few lessons on attraction and needs, easy-medium-hard difficulty levels, quick support response to an email
apps.weak: Subscription not cancellable through Apple, hidden 50-dollar monthly charge, 75-dollar charges with no refund, incoherent content across frameworks, signs of AI text and filler, topic swapped from relationships to erectile dysfunction, extra pay for a coach

apps.title: CoupleGrow - Relationship App
apps.verdict: While it works, couples take to it: the questions and games make them more aware of their relationship, and some call it modern therapy. But the product breaks systematically: people get logged out right after signing in, paid annual accounts vanish without a trace, notifications either don't arrive or dump overnight in a pile, and support goes silent for weeks.
apps.loved: Questions and games raise relationship awareness, help a couple discuss hard things like adults, a finances topic, that early-dating feeling again
apps.weak: Logged out right after signing in, paid annual accounts disappear, support unresponsive for weeks, notifications broken or dumped overnight, much of the good stuff locked behind premium, can't see half of a partner's answers without paying, a promised free entry turns into a charge
apps.whoFor: A couple willing to risk money for questions and games, but the product is too unstable right now to recommend
